title: Computational Insight into the Complexation of DNA-Functionalized Gold Nanoparticles
authors: J. Hingies Monisha; V. Vasumathi; Prabal K Maiti
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究DNA与阳离子配体金纳米颗粒的复合物形成，聚焦DNA弯曲、包裹和结合亲和力，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作相关的广义核酸-纳米颗粒结合建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面研究。
abstract: Ensuring the stability of the AuNP-gene complex until it reaches the target sites is a crucial factor for the success of gene therapy. Though different AuNP sizes and AuNP-to-DNA ratios are investigated for specific therapeutic needs, their role on the stability and packaging of AuNP-DNA complex remains unclear. In this study, we employ all-atom molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the influence of cationic ligand-functionalized AuNP (CAuNP) size and CAuNP-to-DNA ratio on DNA wrapping and binding affinity. The obtained results show that single DNA interacting with smaller CAuNPs exhibit greater bending and wrapping due to their higher curvature. However, when two DNAs bind to smaller CAuNPs, electrostatic repulsion prevents the effective wrapping which leads the DNAs to twist from their original orientation. Such behaviour is not observed with larger CAuNPs since their increased size may mitigates repulsive forces. Further, the analysis on axial bending angle reveals that smaller AuNPs induce sharper DNA bending and larger AuNPs promote smoother bending. In addition, the Potential of Mean Force (PMF) analysis confirms a stronger DNA binding affinity for larger AuNPs with affinity decreasing when two DNAs attach to a single CAuNP. Our results from the DNA loading capacity calculations provide insights into the maximum number of DNA molecules that can be loaded onto CAuNPs of a given size. These findings offer key insights into optimizing the size of AuNP and DNA-to-AuNP ratios for the development of efficient gene delivery systems.
abstract_zh: 确保AuNP-基因复合物在到达靶位点前保持稳定是基因治疗成功的关键因素。尽管针对特定治疗需求研究了不同的AuNP尺寸和AuNP-to-DNA比例，但它们对AuNP-DNA复合物稳定性和包装的作用仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们采用全原子分子动力学 (all-atom molecular dynamics) 模拟，探讨阳离子配体功能化AuNP (CAuNP) 尺寸和CAuNP-to-DNA比例对DNA缠绕和结合亲和力的影响。结果表明，单个DNA与较小CAuNP相互作用时，由于其更高的曲率，表现出更大的弯曲和缠绕。然而，当两个DNA结合到较小CAuNP上时，静电排斥阻止了有效缠绕，导致DNA从其原始方向扭转。这种效应在较大CAuNP上未观察到，因为其增大的尺寸可能缓解了排斥力。此外，轴向弯曲角分析揭示，较小AuNP诱导更尖锐的DNA弯曲，而较大AuNP促进更平滑的弯曲。另外，平均力势 (Potential of Mean Force, PMF) 分析确认，较大AuNP对DNA具有更强的结合亲和力，且当两个DNA附着于单个CAuNP时亲和力降低。我们的DNA负载容量计算结果为给定尺寸CAuNP上可加载的最大DNA分子数提供了见解。这些发现为优化AuNP尺寸和DNA-to-AuNP比例以开发高效基因递送系统提供了关键启示。
